children: Overview
U.S. department store operator's Q2 net sales rose 1.1%, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q2 rose 14% yr/yr; company raised full-year sales and EPS guidance
Company repurchased 2.2 mln shares for $50 mln during Q2
Outlook
Macy's sees 2026 net sales of $21.675 bln to $21.825 bln, up from prior forecast
Company expects 2026 comparable sales to rise 1.0% to 1.5%, up from 0.5%-1.2%
Macy's raises 2026 adjusted diluted EPS outlook to $2.15-$2.35 from $2.00-$2.20
Result Drivers
BLOOMINGDALE'S GROWTH - Bloomingdale’s delivered double-digit comparable sales growth and achieved its highest Q2 sales volume
REIMAGINE 200 STORES - Macy’s said its Reimagine 200 store initiative led to a 1.9% increase in comparable sales at those locations
TARIFF REFUND IMPACT - Net tariff refund benefit contributed to gross margin and adjusted EPS in the quarter
